dict.Clasa A de la 85 de puncte, clasa B de l: Class A from 85 points, class B from 70; below 70 the supplier is class C and you look for another one (Sheets → Offer comparison).
dict.Furnizorii notați la sfârșit de an sau d: Suppliers rated at the end of the year or quarter: on-time deliveries and deliveries without nonconformities, plus the ratings for price and cooperation, give the score out of 100 and the class: A preferred (green), B accepted (yellow) or C to replace (red), with the best supplier on the right.
dict.Livrările și întârzierile se iau din not: Deliveries and delays are taken from the goods receipt notes (Sheets → Goods receipt note); nonconformities, from the notices sent to suppliers.
